Your customers are searching. The question is - can they find you?

  • 93% of online experiences start with a search engine - if you're not visible, you're invisible.
  • Over 60% of Google searches now end without a click, with users taking answers directly from AI Overviews.
  • 1 in 4 people are already using AI tools like ChatGPT to find and recommend businesses.

This report reviews how ready your website is for both worlds: Search (SEO) and AI Answers (AEO). Think of it as making sure your website works as hard as you do.

Critical & Important Findings

High & Medium Severity

Four findings requiring attention to improve search visibility and AI extraction.

Website Health
Website health
2 Severity
The website appears to have a solid technical foundation with clear navigation and essential elements for user experience.
Commercial ConsequenceA robust technical foundation ensures search engines can efficiently crawl, index, and rank the website, contributing to better organic visibility and user accessibility.
→Continue to monitor core web vitals and technical performance to maintain a high-quality user experience and search engine compliance.
⚡ Quick win Priority 1
Google Listing
Missing H1 heading on homepage
0 Severity
The homepage currently lacks an H1 heading. The prominent headline "Experts in Business & Wealth" is not marked up as an H1, which is a critical on-page SEO element.
Commercial ConsequenceWithout an H1, search engines may struggle to quickly identify the primary topic and purpose of the page, potentially reducing its relevance for key search queries and impacting organic rankings. It also makes it harder for AI to summarise the page's core offering.
→Implement an H1 tag for the main headline "Experts in Business & Wealth". This will clearly signal the page's primary topic to search engines and improve content hierarchy.
🔧 Light lift Priority 2
Business Identity
General JSON-LD schema presence
2 Severity
General JSON-LD schema markup is present on the page, which helps search engines understand the content and context of the website.
Commercial ConsequenceStructured data enhances how search engines interpret your content, potentially leading to richer search results (rich snippets) and improved visibility in SERPs.
→Regularly review and update existing schema markup to ensure it accurately reflects the current content and services offered, and explore opportunities for additional relevant schema types.
⚡ Quick win Priority 3
AI Readability
Content structure for AI answer engines
1 Severity
While the main headline "Experts in Business & Wealth" clearly communicates the core offering, the absence of an H1 tag and other structured headings (H2, H3) makes it less optimal for AI answer engines to extract direct answers.
Commercial ConsequenceA poorly structured content hierarchy can hinder AI answer engines from accurately identifying and summarising key information, reducing the likelihood of appearing in featured snippets or direct answers.
→Implement a clear heading structure (H1, H2, H3) to logically organise content. Ensure key questions and answers are explicitly stated and marked up, making it easier for AI to process.
🛠️ Moderate build Priority 4

Customer Questions
FAQ content and schema
2 Severity
No visual FAQ content was detected on the homepage, and consequently, no FAQPage schema markup is present.
Commercial ConsequenceIf there is no FAQ content, there is no opportunity to gain visibility through FAQ rich results or direct answers from AI. This is not a negative impact if FAQ content is not intended for this page.
→If the business intends to answer common customer questions on the homepage, consider adding a dedicated FAQ section. If added, ensure it is marked up with FAQPage JSON-LD schema to maximise AI visibility.
🏗️ Strategic project
AI Presence
Overall AI visibility signals
1 Severity
The website sends mixed signals for AI visibility. While general JSON-LD is present and the core message is clear, the absence of an H1 tag limits its potential for AI answer engine optimisation.
Commercial ConsequenceSuboptimal AI visibility signals can prevent the website from ranking for direct answers, featured snippets, and voice search queries, leading to missed opportunities for organic traffic and brand exposure.
→Prioritise implementing the missing H1 tag and review content for opportunities to explicitly answer common user questions. Consider adding relevant schema types beyond general JSON-LD to enhance AI understanding.
🛠️ Moderate build
